available_at: each history row's own state_publication timestamp
observations: latest two finite valid three-axis observations published by decision; nonpositive or >20ms measurement gap rejected
backward_extrapolation: same fixed bounds if both latest observations are newer than nominal t0 but already published
fallback: C0 with reason, retained in all aggregates
target_support: prior native 20ms gap and original per-window support_start/end; reject missing, no extrapolation
integration: original integrate(), causal initial attitude and velocity unchanged, no attitude reset; prescribed future labels only for offline kinematics
comparison: common contiguous supported prefix and complete H1000 windows separately; no unpaired support comparison
